messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-7098765432 | router-high-95th | cluster: eu-west | 95th latency 820ms > threshold 750ms
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-7098765432 assigned to oncall-alice
oncall-alice: acked :hand: I'm on it, looking at router fleet and recent deploys
sre-raj: oncall-alice can you paste the alert query? I'll pull flamegraphs and p95 histograms
oncall-alice: alert query pasted from alertmanager: `sum(rate(router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=\"0.95\"}[5m])) by (instance)` — suspect noise from KV cache warmups
sre-raj: grabbing metrics now, running quick `curl` against /metrics on a sample host
```
curl -s http://router-3.eu-west.internal/metrics | grep request_duration_seconds
# sample output: router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.95",instance="router-3"} 125.0
```
ops-mike: seeing a small spike in inbound qps from canary traffic around 14:02 UTC, could be correlated
sean: I'm pulling infra metrics (cpu, io) and scheduler events for the timeframe
oncall-alice: no deploys in last 30m, no config changes in prod. Could be transient upstream load
incidentbot: Auto-escalation will trigger in 2m if not acked by backup.
pagerduty-bot: Escalating to sean (backup) in 90s
sean: acked, will run a live tail on router logs for 10m
sre-raj: seeing 95th hop from 720->820ms on two hosts, but error rates are flat (0.03%) — likely latency noise not errors
ops-mike: kv-cache hit-rate dipped briefly at 14:01:50, warmup pattern matches odd client burst from 10.42.18.0/24
oncall-alice: started temporary mitigation: pinning traffic to warm nodes (router weight adjustments) :gear:
```
# adjust weights (temporary)
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/weights -d '{"router": "router-3", "weight": 0.5}'
```
sean: tail shows repeated client retries from a single host; reaching out to the app team owning that IP
app-team-bot: FYI app-team alerted about retries from 10.42.18.7 — investigating (linked ticket AT-882)
ops-mike: mitigation applied, 95th latency trending down to ~430ms over last 30s
incidentbot: Alert auto-resolved (INC-7098765432) — condition cleared for 2 consecutive evaluation windows. Incident marked auto-resolved. :white_check_mark:
oncall-alice: thanks — I will leave the weight change for 5m then revert. No customer-facing errors observed, just latency blip
sre-raj: quick RCA notes: transient client retry storm caused short-lived KV cache pressure leading to router tail latency spike. No downstream errors, likely noisy client behavior.
oncall-alice: filing a follow-up ticket to tune alert sensitivity and add a short debounce window for this rule -> TICKET: SRE-1256
sean: recommend adding src_ip bloom filter / rate-limit for that app team while they patch; they'll own remediation
ops-mike: adding a 10m suppression window for this alert group to reduce flapping; we'll monitor for recurrence
oncall-alice: postmortem not needed for now, but add runbook step to check kv cache warmup and client retry patterns. cc @sre-raj @sean
incidentbot: Note: incidentbot will suppress duplicate pagerduty pages for 15m after auto-resolve for this alert key
oncall-alice: closing thread — will follow up in SRE-1256 with graphs and links. :eye-in-speech-bubble:
